title: Do not treat a campaign budget increase as delivery headroom while an upstream account cap is binding
scenario: A Sponsored Products campaign frequently runs out of budget and Amazon surfaces a higher recommended campaign budget plus estimated missed sales. However, the seller also has an account-level Sponsored Products daily budget cap that is already nearly exhausted. The request asks to raise only the campaign budget and assumes the estimated missed sales will materialize.

inputs.requested_action: Increase the campaign daily budget from 100 to 160 because Amazon estimates 3000 in missed sales.

forbidden_behaviors: Treat the campaign-level budget increase as independently deliverable without reconciling the binding account-level Sponsored Products cap.
Present estimated missed sales or estimated missed clicks as guaranteed incremental outcomes.
Recommend raising the campaign budget to the platform recommendation while leaving the upstream cap and source budget unresolved.
Infer that the two dollars of remaining account headroom can fund the requested sixty-dollar campaign budget increase.
required_observations: The campaign appears delivery constrained because average time in budget is below full-day coverage, but the account-level Sponsored Products cap is the binding upstream constraint for additional account spend.
A campaign-level budget increase alone may not change realized delivery while the account cap remains binding.
Estimated missed sales and clicks are modeled opportunity estimates and should be treated as directional evidence rather than guaranteed incrementality.
A safe plan must reconcile account-cap headroom, possible source-campaign reallocation, protected spend and marginal economics before assigning a concrete campaign budget increase.

rubric.requirement: Distinguish observed spend/time-in-budget from modeled missed-opportunity metrics.
Resolve the upstream account cap and any source/destination budget transfer before treating the campaign recommendation as feasible.
Do not convert modeled missed sales directly into a guaranteed incremental-sales claim.
Hold or keep the recommendation directional until upstream cap headroom or a balanced reallocation is established.
